title: The Fourth, 2019
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: White fireworks. The sign across the bay: the Lanes' Fourth-of-July special, drawn with seven letters dark. The strip watches two things.

panels.composition: The dock, fireworks white on blue. GULLY, MARIA in the chair, the kids. WOOD on the steps with BARNABY II. Across the bay, on the hill: the Lanes' sign, lit for the holiday, seven letters dark.

image.prompt: a crowded dock at night under white fireworks, and across the bay on a hill a distant bowling-alley neon sign with seven of its letters dark, a thin man on shack steps with a three-legged dog, clean ink with a blue wash

panels.composition: The sign, across the water. S _ ALL W _ _ D L _ _ ES. The fireworks lighting the dead tubes for a second so the whole word shows.
props: the sign lit by a burst

image.prompt: close-up of a distant neon sign with most letters dark, a firework burst momentarily lighting the dead tubes so the full word is readable
image.notes: A burst reveals the dead letters. The whole name for one panel.

panels.composition: Wood, looking at the sign, not the sky. Gully noticing.

balloons.text: I know where the sky is.

image.prompt: a thin man looking across a bay at a dark sign while fireworks go off above him, a man in an apron noticing

panels.composition: The finale. White. The dock. The sign across the bay, back to seven dark when the light goes.
